en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al Hassan Bin Salih Al Sowry, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>

having said that Amir Al-Momineenasws ordered Qanbar that he should whip a man, a Penalty (Hadd). So Qanbar was harsh, and increased by three lashes. So Aliasws caused retaliation from Qanbar of the three (excessive) lashes’.
